lastSession: 2026-06-28 — Live monitoring fix: delivery-trail route rewrite + flicker fix
currentPhase: Production day 1 — live monitoring critical fix
currentStep: Rewrote delivery-trail query approach (staff→assignments→items→survey_units instead of all survey_units), added keepPreviousData, added selectedCity to offset reset
keyDecisions: Old approach: fetch ALL survey_units in city (100K rows, capped at 1000 by PostgREST) → items by PSID (URL exceeded 300 limit). List showed/hid on every poll.
New approach: staff by city → daily_assignments → items (today's deliveries only, small set) → survey_units by PSID. No 1000-row limit, no 300-item URL limit.
total_items from daily_assignments replaces the expensive totalByAssignment query on assignment_items.
keepPreviousData prevents the list from wiping clean on every poll refetch.
selectedCity added to offset reset dependency so switching cities resets the feed.
Single-session enforcement made non-blocking: GoTrue Admin API DELETE failing was blocking login. Now best-effort — if revoke fails, session from sign-in is still valid.
nextActions: Push to Vercel — login no longer blocked by session revoke
Check Vercel Function Logs for sign-out-other-sessions errors to diagnose GoTrue issue
